name: Playwright Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Target environment'
        required: true
        default: 'test'
        type: choice
        options:
          - test
          - preprod
          - dev
      feature:
        description: 'Feature tag to run (leave empty to run all)'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write
  pull-requests: write

env:
  ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.environment || 'test' }}
  FEATURE: ${{ inputs.feature || '' }}
  XML_REPORT_PATH: playwright-report/results.xml
  JIRA_URL: https://devstack.vwgroup.com/jira
  JIRA_PROJECT_KEY: CEBRA
  JIRA_USERNAME: f30io93
  JIRA_TEST_EXEC_KEY_TEST: CEBRA-4288
  JIRA_TEST_EXEC_KEY_PREPROD: CEBRA-5578
  JIRA_TEST_EXEC_KEY_DEV: CEBRA-5682

jobs:
  execute-tests:
    name: Execute Tests
    timeout-minutes: 60
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository   // here we checkout the code from the repository (copy the code to the runner so that subsequent steps can access it)
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: 'npm'
          registry-url: 'https://jfrog.devstack.vwgroup.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm/'

      - name: Validate npm auth secret
        shell: bash
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$NPM_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing required secret: NPM_TOKEN"
            echo "::error::Create a JFrog Artifactory access token with read access to npm repository and save it as NPM_TOKEN in GitHub Actions secrets."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Cache Playwright browsers
        id: playwright-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: playwright-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}

      - name: Install Playwright Browser
        if: steps.playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npx playwright install

      - name: Validate required test secrets
        shell: bash
        env:
          ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ADMIN_PASSWORD }}
          PROJECT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PROJECT_PASSWORD }}
          AUDIT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.AUDIT_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          missing=0
          for v in ADMIN_PASSWORD PROJECT_PASSWORD AUDIT_PASSWORD; do
            if [ -z "${!v}" ]; then
              echo "::error::Missing required secret: $v"
              missing=1
            fi
          done
          if [ "$missing" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: |
          if [ -z "$FEATURE" ]; then
            npx playwright test
          else
            npx playwright test -g "$FEATURE"
          fi
        env:
          ENVIRONMENT: ${{ env.ENVIRONMENT }}
          FEATURE: ${{ env.FEATURE }}
          ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ADMIN_PASSWORD }}
          PROJECT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PROJECT_PASSWORD }}
          AUDIT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.AUDIT_PASSWORD }}
          CI: true

      - name: Upload Playwright Report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

  publish-report:
    name: Publish Report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: execute-tests
    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Download Playwright Report
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v6
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/

      - name: Check test results file
        id: results
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ -f "playwright-report/results.xml" ]; then
            echo "has_results=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "has_results=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "No test results file found; skipping test-reporter step."
          fi

      - name: Upload XML Report to Xray & attach HTML report
        if: ${{ steps.results.outputs.has_results == 'true' }}
        env:
          JIRA_SECRET: ${{ secrets.JIRA_SECRET }}
        run: bash .github/scripts/upload.sh

      - name: Publish Test Results
        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: Playwright Test Results
          path: playwright-report/results.xml
          reporter: java-junit
          fail-on-error: false
